about: The commands the front door may propose. Reviewed by hand: an endpoint is not a command until it is listed here. `roles` only narrows what the agent is shown; the endpoint and the database still decide what a person may do. Nothing that decides, pays, files, posts or removes access is listed, and nothing under /approvals, /inbox or /worker-controls.

commands.summary: Open a requisition and start hiring for an open position
commands.when_to_use: The person wants to hire someone for an open position or seat.

commands.summary: Enter a candidate's application on a requisition
commands.when_to_use: The person has a candidate to add to an open requisition.

commands.summary: Ask a candidate for consent to process their data
commands.when_to_use: The person wants the candidate on a requisition to be asked for data-processing consent.

commands.summary: Start an employee's exit (termination or resignation)
commands.when_to_use: The person wants to start the exit process for an employee.

commands.summary: Prepare a payroll run for a legal entity and period
commands.when_to_use: The person wants to run or prepare payroll for a period.

commands.summary: Ask for approval to pay out a prepared payroll run (someone else approves; nothing is paid yet)
commands.when_to_use: The person wants a prepared payroll run sent for approval to be paid.

commands.summary: Issue payslips for a payroll run that has already been paid
commands.when_to_use: The person wants payslips issued for a paid run.

commands.summary: Prepare the ledger entry for a payroll run and ask for approval to post it (nothing is posted yet)
commands.when_to_use: The person wants a payroll run's accounting entry prepared.

commands.summary: Create a timecard for an employee and period
commands.when_to_use: The person wants to start a timecard for a pay period.

commands.summary: Accrue leave for an employee under a leave policy up to a date
commands.when_to_use: The person wants to add earned leave to someone's balance.

commands.summary: Choose a benefit plan and coverage tier
commands.when_to_use: The person wants to enrol in or choose a benefit plan.

commands.summary: Submit an expense claim for approval
commands.when_to_use: The person wants to claim back money they spent.
The person wants to see open or recent requisitions.
The person wants to find or list colleagues.
